assets.name: The Etsy shop itself (reviews + tenure as a compounding search-rank asset)
assets.what: Treat the Etsy shop as durable infrastructure, not a one-time listing: every review and every month of clean customer-service metrics permanently raises the shop's baseline search rank for all future listings, including the RT exam guide launched later into the same shop.

claims.statement: Etsy's own handbook: search ranking includes 'shop's average review rating, message response rate, and case rate from the past three months.'
claims.source_excerpt: shop's average review rating, message response rate, and case rate from the past three months in our search ranking.

claims.statement: Etsy's own handbook: 'Great reviews and an About section may improve your shop's search ranking while intellectual property issues and cases can hurt it.'
claims.source_excerpt: Great reviews and an About section may improve your shop's search ranking while intellectual property issues and cases can hurt it.

claims.statement: Etsy's handbook does not name shop age/tenure as a ranking factor (only review rating, response rate, case rate, conversion, shipping are listed).
claims.source_excerpt: factors: customer service quality (reviews, response rate, case rate) and shoppers' habits (Context Specific Ranking) — no tenure/age factor named.

claims.statement: Etsy sellers report inconsistent review-to-sale ratios: 625 sales/163 reviews (~26%) vs ~1-in-5 elsewhere; a prior factory finding clocked one listing at ~1-in-100.
claims.source_excerpt: sellers report ratios from roughly 1-in-4 to 1-in-20+ reviews per sale, with wide individual variation

claims.statement: New Etsy shops report widely varying time-to-first-sale: 1-3 weeks is common with any promotion, but 3-6 months is also commonly reported with no following.
claims.source_excerpt: many reckon it takes 3-6 months to get your first sale... some sellers reported getting their first sale within days, others waited months

assets.time_to_first_effect: First review possible within days of first sale; meaningful rank lift from accumulated reviews/tenure realistically takes 2-4 months of consistent sales (unproven exact threshold — Etsy does not publish a number).
assets.first_step: List both product lines in one shop now (even before RT guide is built) so the shop clock and review count start accruing immediately; ask every buyer directly for a review.
why_it_might_fail: Zero-audience shop may get zero sales for months, so there is nothing for reviews to accrue against
Etsy's own docs are silent on tenure, so 'shop age helps' may be seller folklore, not an actual lever Dustan can pull
One shop serving two unrelated niches (CRE + RT exam) may dilute Etsy's Context-Specific Ranking signal for either

assets.name: Organic Pinterest pinning to Etsy listings
assets.what: Free, unpaid Pinterest pins (static + Idea Pins) linking directly to Etsy listings, using Dustan's existing Pinterest account; pins have a long shelf life vs. other social feeds so a small weekly batch compounds.

claims.statement: Pinterest's own Etsy case study covered a paid six-week ads campaign, not organic pinning, and reported a 'total sales lift of 4.5%' in early 2021.
claims.source_excerpt: six-week campaign...measurement test...total sales lift of 4.5% in the first two quarters of 2021

claims.statement: An Etsy seller on Etsy's own forum reported ~100 views/day from Pinterest on an item a stranger pinned months earlier, even after it was delisted.
claims.source_excerpt: about 100 views a day from Pinterest on an item pinned by a stranger... traffic every day even though the item was no longer being sold

claims.statement: Other Etsy forum sellers report the opposite: Pinterest is only their #4 traffic source, or pins get 'a couple of repins and no sales increase.'
claims.source_excerpt: Pinterest ranks as the number 4 source of shop referrals... results vary significantly among sellers

claims.statement: Seller-blog claims of organic-Pinterest wins (e.g. '314% sales increase in 4 months,' '50,000 visits/month') cite no first-party dataset or methodology.
claims.source_excerpt: results build slowly over three to six months...pins don't peak in traffic until they are around 4 months old

assets.time_to_first_effect: No reliable first-party number exists; self-reported and marketing-blog sources both cluster around 3-6 months before pins produce measurable Etsy traffic, but Etsy forum evidence shows results are highly inconsistent and can be near-zero.
assets.first_step: Pin every existing/new Etsy listing photo with a keyword-rich title/description this week; batch 5-10 pins in one sitting rather than daily manual posting.
why_it_might_fail: The only first-party Pinterest+Etsy case study is about paid ads, which Dustan will not run, so there is no verified organic benchmark to hold this to
Pinterest's own follower count for the account is unknown, and cold pins on a small account may get near-zero initial impressions
CRE offering-memorandum templates are a poor visual/Pinterest-native fit (Pinterest skews DIY/home/craft); the RT exam guide is a better fit but still unproven on Pinterest

assets.name: Email list built from a free lead-magnet/checklist funnel
assets.what: A one-page free download (e.g., a CRE due-diligence checklist or an RT exam blueprint one-pager) hosted on mindsovermatters.co, captured via Formspree into Gmail/Supabase, later used to soft-pitch the paid Etsy product to people who already showed topical interest.

claims.statement: Unbounce's aggregate study (~41,000 pages, 57M conversions, Q4 2024) found median landing-page conversion of 6.6%; email traffic converts far higher (19.3%) than organic search (6.4%).
claims.source_excerpt: median conversion rate across industries from more than 57 million conversions, 41,000 landing pages...is 6.6%

claims.statement: Aggregate reporting states short lead-magnet formats (quizzes ~35-40%, short video ~61% mobile) convert far above classic static gated PDFs (~11%).
claims.source_excerpt: quizzes hit 35-40% versus around 11% for classic gated content

claims.statement: Factory run-1 lesson: 'Never score owned channel from a channel's existence; score it from its measured size' — Dustan has 0 known subscribers today.
claims.source_excerpt: Never score "owned channel" from a channel's existence; score it from its measured size.

assets.time_to_first_effect: Technically instant once traffic exists (signups can occur same day), but this asset has no traffic source of its own — it only converts visitors sent by Pinterest, the directory, or Etsy listing traffic, so its real first-effect date is downstream of those.
assets.first_step: Build one single-purpose freebie for whichever product line is closer to launch, put a Formspree form behind it on an existing GitHub Pages route, and add the link to every Etsy listing description.
why_it_might_fail: An email list with zero starting traffic sources stays at zero regardless of the freebie's quality — this is an amplifier for other assets, not a standalone acquisition channel
No first-party case study found of an Etsy-adjacent seller converting a freebie list into template/guide sales with hard numbers
212 CSSI referral contacts are explicitly off-limits per factory lesson (no cold pitch, value-add only to non-prospect contacts), so this list starts from zero, not from an existing base

assets.name: Niche resource/directory page for long-tail SEO
assets.what: A free, content-rich resource hub (e.g., 'CRE Offering Memorandum Resources' or 'NBRC RT Exam 2027 Study Resources') published as a static page on the existing GitHub Pages site, targeting long-tail search queries and linking out to the paid Etsy listing.

claims.statement: SEO agency/blog case studies report niche directory sites reaching 14,000-75,000 monthly visitors only after 7-24 months of sustained publishing, not weeks.
claims.source_excerpt: grew from 0 to over 14,400 monthly visitors within 11 months

claims.statement: A solo builder reports building a directory (Airtable+Softr, single-keyword SEO) and later selling it; no verifiable traffic/time numbers were retrievable from the source in this session.
claims.source_excerpt: SEO-first approach, targeting the keyword 'email newsletter examples'...set it and forget it business

assets.time_to_first_effect: General SEO knowledge and every case study found agree: 4-12+ months before Google sends meaningful organic traffic to a brand-new page/domain path, regardless of content quality.
assets.first_step: Publish one long-tail page (e.g., 'CRE offering memorandum template checklist') on mindsovermatters.co this week, targeting a specific search phrase with no existing strong competitor, and link it to the Etsy listing.
why_it_might_fail: All specific traffic-number case studies found are from SEO agencies selling services or unverifiable solo-builder blogs — no first-party, audited data exists
mindsovermatters.co has no existing domain authority or backlinks, so even a well-written page competes from zero
4-12 month payback window is long relative to the 30-day first-dollar preference in scout.md, so this is a background asset, not a launch lever

assets.name: Amazon KDP Author Central page (for the RT exam prep guide only)
assets.what: Publishing the RT exam prep guide as a Kindle/paperback on KDP in addition to the Etsy PDF creates a free, permanent Amazon Author Page (bio, book list, 'Follow' button) that surfaces in Amazon search/browse for exam-prep buyers who never see Etsy.

claims.statement: Amazon's KDP help docs: Author Central 'lets you create your Author Page...share information about yourself and your books...helps readers find your books,' and it is free.
claims.source_excerpt: create your Author Page...share the most up-to-date information about yourself and your books with millions of readers

claims.statement: Amazon's Follow feature on an Author Page notifies followers when the author releases or pre-lists a new book — a free repeat-buyer mechanism for future guides.
claims.source_excerpt: Follow button...allows Amazon customers to add you to their favorite authors...notified of your book's release

assets.time_to_first_effect: Author page itself goes live same-day on publishing; no first-party data was found on how long a zero-review KDP title takes to surface in Amazon search — treated as not_public.
assets.first_step: Once the RT exam guide content exists, format and publish a KDP paperback/ebook edition alongside the Etsy PDF, and complete the free Author Central profile the same day.
why_it_might_fail: No first-party evidence was found for how new, zero-review KDP titles actually rank/sell without an existing author following — general KDP forum sentiment is that visibility is hard-won, same problem as Etsy
Formatting a study guide for Kindle/print adds real production hours beyond the Etsy PDF version
Serves only one of the two product lines (a spreadsheet-style CRE template does not fit the KDP book format)

disagreements: Etsy's own seller-handbook pages list review rating, response rate, case rate, conversion rate and shipping price as ranking factors, but never name shop age/tenure — yet third-party SEO blogs (Printful, eRank) commonly assert 'listing/shop age' as a ranking factor. Treat 'age helps' as unverified seller folklore, not confirmed by Etsy's primary documentation.

Etsy review-to-sale ratio estimates disagree by an order of magnitude across sources: one seller-tool site claims 5-15% of buyers leave reviews (multiply reviews by 7-20x for true sales), forum posts report ratios from roughly 1-in-4 to 1-in-20+, and a prior factory run found one listing at ~1-in-100 — there is no single reliable multiplier.

Widely-cited organic-Pinterest-to-Etsy success numbers ('314% sales increase in 4 months', '50,000 visits/month', '20% of traffic') all trace to marketing/seller blogs with no first-party data cited, while the only genuine first-party Pinterest+Etsy case study (Pinterest Business's own) measured a PAID ad campaign's 4.5% sales lift, not organic pinning — the two are being conflated across the sources found.

Any first-party Amazon/KDP data on time-to-first-sale or search-visibility ramp for a zero-review new title
